Annotation Interface Range

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(FIELD) public @interface Range
Validation annotation to enforce numeric boundaries on a field value.

This field-level annotation is used by Validator to ensure that numeric field values fall within the specified min/max range (inclusive). Works with any numeric type (int, double, Integer, Double, etc.).

Example Usage:

@Range(min = 18, max = 120, message = "Age must be between 18 and 120")
private int age;
Since:
1.0.0
